summary: Added meterbill/money.py with all rounding rules, routed every module through it, removed the decimal-context line, and kept the half-up (bill/quote/tariffs) vs half-even (batch worker threads) behaviours via a keyword-only `method` parameter. Existing tests pass and tests/test_money.py was added; quirks kept as-is: batch rounds band charges and per-kWh prices half-even, and the 'whole' payable never prints '-0'.
